abstract: Using annular webs and Kazhdan-Lusztig mu-coefficients, we disprove Guralnick's absolute boundedness conjecture for first cohomology.
hook: Guralnick's conjecture bounding first cohomology is false.
summary: The authors disprove the absolute boundedness conjecture for first cohomology using annular webs and Kazhdan-Lusztig mu-coefficients. The abstract is a single sentence, so the size and form of the counterexamples are not stated here.
title: Annular webs and Guralnick's conjecture
